news.headline: Dickson Agu honored after a 14-tackle game
news.summary: Agu made 14 tackles in Saturday's win over South Alabama, the most by a Tulane player in a game since 2023. On Tuesday he was named one of six national comeback players of the week, a year after a knee injury cost him most of last season.

news.headline: Two Tulane players hurt with Kansas State next
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that linebacker Chris Rodgers is getting a second opinion and that the team is still finding out how long tight end Ty Thompson will be out. Tulane plays Saturday morning at Kansas State, which is 2-0.

news.headline: Jaylin Lucas honored by the American Conference
news.summary: The conference put Lucas on its weekly honor roll Monday for his 214 yards and a touchdown against South Alabama. He averaged 19.5 yards a carry, a conference record for a player with at least 10 carries in a game.

news.headline: Florida will wait on Eric Singleton for Saturday
news.summary: Florida listed receiver Eric Singleton as questionable on Wednesday for the game at Auburn, the school he played for last season. He hurt his ankle on September 5 and will dress and try to play, and lineman Emmanuel Oyebadejo is questionable too.

news.headline: Aaron Philo makes his first SEC start Saturday
news.summary: Philo has thrown for 517 yards and five touchdowns in Florida's two wins and has completed more than 76 percent of his passes. Saturday at Auburn is his first road start and his first game against an SEC team.

news.headline: Sumrall goes to Auburn, where his family has ties
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall grew up in Alabama and his wife went to Auburn, so he was asked about family cheering against him Saturday. He said Florida pays his mortgage, and the Gators are going for their first 3-0 start since 2019.

news.headline: Derrek Cooper is back for Texas, Nick Townsend is not
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Thursday that running back Derrek Cooper will play Saturday against UTSA. Cooper sprained his ankle in the opener and sat out the Ohio State game, and tight end Nick Townsend, who hurt his knee in that game, is not expected to play.

news.headline: Arch Manning apologizes to a TV reporter
news.summary: A fake video made by a computer showed Texas coach Steve Sarkisian slapping ESPN reporter Holly Rowe, and Manning laughed about it when he was asked at Monday's news conference. He apologized on Tuesday and said there is nothing funny about it, and Rowe said she accepts his apology.

news.headline: Arch Manning is the SEC offensive player of the week
news.summary: The SEC gave Manning the award Monday for bringing Texas back from 20 points down against Ohio State. On the three fourth-quarter drives that won the game he threw for 125 yards and a touchdown and ran for 26 more.

news.headline: Olave and Young are questionable for Sunday
news.summary: The Saints' final report Friday listed receiver Chris Olave with a hamstring problem and pass rusher Chase Young with a calf problem, so both are uncertain at Baltimore. Alvin Kamara and Cam Jordan have no injury tag and are set to play.

news.headline: Zach Wood goes on injured reserve
news.summary: The Saints put Zach Wood, who snaps the ball on field goals and punts, on injured reserve Friday with a hurt calf. They also moved running back CJ Donaldson up from the practice squad to the main roster.

news.headline: Alvin Kamara says he will play Sunday
news.summary: Kamara hurt his knee in August and was told it would take about six weeks. He practiced in full two days in a row and said Thursday that he feels good and is playing at Baltimore.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: IUP wins twice in West Virginia
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks beat Shepherd and then Millersville on Friday and did not lose a set in either match. IUP has now won seven in a row and is 8-3.

news.headline: Delaney Concannon wins a conference weekly award
news.summary: Concannon had 49 kills and 52 digs across four wins at IUP's home tournament last weekend. She leads the Crimson Hawks with 105 kills through nine matches.

news.headline: Aaron Judge says his leg is nothing serious
news.summary: Judge said the tightness in his lower right leg is a small thing that comes with getting back up to speed, and he does not expect to need any tests. He came out of Wednesday's game at Minnesota in the sixth inning as a precaution.

news.headline: Yankees lose in 13 innings at Minnesota
news.summary: New York led three different times Wednesday and could not hold any of them, and the Twins won 5-4 on a single by Victor Caratini in the 13th inning. Anthony Volpe had two hits and two runs batted in, and the Yankees are now 88-64.

news.headline: Clarke Schmidt pitches for the first time in 14 months
news.summary: The Yankees brought the pitcher back Wednesday, about 14 months after elbow surgery. He came into the game at Minnesota in the seventh inning and struck out two, and infielder Oswaldo Cabrera was dropped from the roster to make room.
